definitions: Colson Baker (born in Houston, Texas, on April 22, 1990), also known as Machine Gun Kelly, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor.

Richard Colson Baker (born in Houston, Texas, on April 22, 1990), most famously known as Machine Gun Kelly, is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor. He is noted for his genre diversity, having explored hip hop, rock, and pop punk across his discography.
examples: Machine Gun Kelly's latest album topped the charts.
I saw Machine Gun Kelly in concert last night.
Machine Gun Kelly has collaborated with many artists.
